It was a tale of good versus evil, the heroic agents of Spectrum

which say brave narrative choice, and most people remember one thing about it:
the weird decision to do big scene transitions like this.

when you only have four TV channels and no internet. Rewatching it as an adult for this video?

and the production didn't shy away from that by cutting to a reaction shot of other characters.

rocket cannons, ejector seats, and a jet pack. Almost every episode,
